positive_lineage: ports.py explicitly centralizes live service ports, separates known-dead ports and introduces per-instance FRANK_PORT_BASE offset semantics.
instanz.py delegates port truth to ports.py and injects existing environment-variable interfaces rather than independently recalculating ports.
paths.py centralizes a large historical set of database/state/data paths and supports environment overrides.
GPU detection captures resolved hardware/backend characteristics and Genesis thresholds are explicit data rather than hidden constants.

executed_reproductions.observed: paths.MODELS_DIR resolved to override_models while paths.MODEL_PATHS['subconscious'] remained data/models/subconscious.pt

executed_reproductions.setup: import config.paths first, then import config.instanz with FRANK_ROOT set
executed_reproductions.observed: instanz updated os.environ['AICORE_DATA'] but the already-bound paths.AICORE_DATA constant remained at its earlier value
config.ports silently set PORT_BASE=0 and core remained 8088

executed_reproductions.setup: config.paths.get_db('typo_name') in an isolated data root
executed_reproductions.observed: returned and created parent for data/db/typo_name.db rather than rejecting unknown registry key

findings.evidence: instanz.py says early import is sufficient and mutates environment at import time. paths.py resolves module-level constants at import time. Executed reproduction proves late instance injection cannot rebind already-imported path constants.
findings.effect: Boot/import order changes which data root/runtime paths some modules use; one process can contain two configuration epochs.
findings.required_contract: No import-time configuration mutation. Construct one immutable InstanceConfig/BootManifest before subsystem initialization and inject it explicitly into all modules.

findings.evidence: paths.py defines MODELS_DIR=AICORE_DATA/models, constructs MODEL_PATHS from it, then later reassigns MODELS_DIR from AICORE_MODELS_DIR. Executed reproduction confirms MODEL_PATHS retain the old directory.
findings.effect: Different components can read/write different model roots while both believe they use the centralized config.
findings.required_contract: Resolve root configuration once, then derive every dependent path after overrides are final; immutable config validation must reject duplicate/reassigned root definitions.

findings.evidence: get_db/get_state fall back to constructing arbitrary <name>.db/.json paths for unknown names. Executed reproduction creates typo_name.db path without error.
findings.effect: Typos or divergent subsystem names can silently fork persistence into new files, defeating a canonical unified database/state registry.
findings.required_contract: Production get_db/get_state are closed-world typed registry lookups. Unknown identities fail loudly; explicit dynamic namespaces, if needed, use a separate API with provenance.

findings.evidence: ports.py catches ValueError parsing FRANK_PORT_BASE and silently resets it to 0. Executed reproduction with non-integer input maps core to the prime 8088 port.
findings.effect: A malformed twin configuration can collapse onto Prime's ports instead of refusing to start.
findings.required_contract: Instance identity/port offset validation is fail-closed and collision-checked before any bind. Invalid configuration cannot default into another identity.

findings.evidence: adi_config.py hardcodes llm_url 127.0.0.1:8105 and a ~/.config/frank user path; fas_popup_config.py hardcodes /tmp/fas_popup_state.json and ~/.config/frank/fas_popup.json; logging_config.py hardcodes ~/.local/share/frank/logs instead of the central instance paths.
findings.effect: A shifted/twin instance can still address Prime's LLM or collide in UI state/config/logs despite the central port/path modules.
findings.required_contract: Harness must scan/runtime-trace every filesystem/network endpoint against InstanceConfig; no hardcoded instance-scoped path/port remains outside the canonical manifest.

findings.evidence: detect_gpu treats an unavailable/unknown forced AICORE_GPU_BACKEND as a reason to continue auto-detection rather than fail the requested backend configuration.
findings.effect: An experiment can silently execute on a different backend than the requested one unless resolved backend is separately recorded.
findings.required_contract: Distinguish preferred backend from required backend; required mismatch fails, resolved hardware/backend is persisted in every benchmark/training/runtime epoch.

cross_source_lineage.interpretation: The Drive config contains a later centralization effort layered over older PF configuration; the fixes themselves still have partial-centralization/import-order defects and must be reconciled rather than blindly copied.

frank: FRANK identity includes one immutable instance/boot manifest; a process cannot contain mixed config epochs.
harness: Add config-order permutation tests, invalid-instance fail-closed tests, hardcoded endpoint scans and two-instance isolation tests covering LLM/DB/log/temp/UI state.
claycode: Paths, ports, artifact identities and runtime endpoints are typed capabilities/handles, not literal strings emitted or interpreted ad hoc.
unifieddb: Eliminate silent dynamic DB-name fallback; persistence namespaces are schema-registered and migration-versioned.
claygraph: Bind every state/artifact node to instance_id and boot_epoch so twins cannot merge histories accidentally.
gwt: Broadcast verified instance identity/current substrate endpoints as state, never infer them from default ports or filenames.
clay: Dissolving modules into one binary is an opportunity to eliminate import-order configuration side effects entirely.
